Germline Bap1-mutant vs wild-type mice exposed to asbestos; mesothelioma incidence and onset measured—clear genetic susceptibility.
Conditional mesothelial HMGB1-knockout mice exposed to asbestos; mesothelioma incidence, latency and survival measured.

Nf2+/-;Cdkn2a+/- mice used as fixed model to test chemopreventive drugs; genetic modification's effect on susceptibility not the study aim.
ADAR2 manipulation studied for chemoresistance, growth and microenvironment in established mesothelioma, not susceptibility to asbestos-induced development.
RBM8A RNA-editing translational-regulation mechanism in cells; no genetic modification tested for mesothelioma susceptibility in vivo.
Mechanistic study of BAP1-HMGB1-HDAC1 complex in cells/human sera; no mouse mesothelioma incidence, latency or burden measured.
Focus on dysregulated translatome and mTOR-targeted therapy in mesothelioma; genetic modification's effect on asbestos susceptibility not studied.

p53+/- mice exposed to fibre-like MWCNTs, tumor development assessed as susceptibility factor; borderline fibre/outcome, cannot confidently exclude.
DMT1-transgenic mice given crocidolite; mesothelioma incidence and survival compared to wild-type showing delayed carcinogenesis—susceptibility study.
Asbestos-exposed NF2+/- and NF2+/-CR-/- mice compared for mesothelioma survival; genetic modifications and mesothelioma outcome present.
Asc-deficient mice exposed to asbestos; mesothelioma incidence and latency compared to wild-type—genetic susceptibility.
